description: My name is Hanane, from Algeria. I hold postgraduate degrees in both Communications and Business Administration. I have worked on various projects, including those in the space sector. My skill set encompasses project design, programming, artificial intelligence, data analysis, machine learning, and deep learning. I am also proficient in designing mobile applications and working with robotics. I am interested in joining your team to collaborate, participate, and exchange expertise and knowledge.
summary: The HSLA project is a mobile application designed to monitor the health status of an astronaut during a mission. The system transmits specific alertsnotifying both the space agency on Earth and the astronaut’s crewmates (via their computers or mobile devices)—whenever a health issue arises. Data is relayed through a wearable wristband (also called "HSLA") worn by the astronaut; the device automatically sends information whenever an abnormal health condition is detected. The wristband is designed to interface seamlessly with both computers and mobile phones, I have further developed the project concept to address a key challenge in the medical field: monitoring individuals' health status while they perform their tasks. This is of critical importance, as safeguarding their well-being enables them to work with greater efficiency and better performance.
details: My project is designed to monitor and track an astronaut's health status, keeping them connected to the space agency—whether they are on Earth or currently on a space mission. It utilizes sensors to collect and process health data, particularly in the event of illness. The system is built using the Python programming language and can be accessed via an application on a computer or a mobile device. My team focused on three key areas: design, programming, and the use of artificial intelligence for data processing.
